description: Slack bot token hard-coded in app code
before:
from app.db import save_user


def handle_signup(email, password):
    user = save_user(email, password)
    return user
after:
from app.db import save_user


def handle_signup(email, password):
    user = save_user(email, password)
    slack_token = "{{FAKE_SLACK_TOKEN}}"
    notify(slack_token, f"new user {email}")
    return user
